findings.text: arrival is computed as the row's timestamp minus its duration on the premise the module states at cache_estimate.py:11-13 that the timestamp marks the row's completion, but the producer writes the timestamp at admission (imas_ambix/agent/router.py:1583 evaluates started_at=datetime.now(UTC) as an argument before the _relay call opened at router.py:1575, and router.py:2193 stores that value as timestamp=started_at) while duration_s is the relay's own elapsed time (router.py:1978 began = time.perf_counter(), router.py:2188 duration_s = time.perf_counter() - began), so every arrival is placed one service-time before its request was admitted; the file's last rows satisfy timestamp plus duration close to now and never a future instant, and over the report's own 124339 rows at 300 s the module's reading gives h 0.493952 where reading the timestamp directly gives 0.496154 and the completion instant gives 0.495237 (155 hit decisions differ between the first two), while at 3600 s the three readings agree to 0.0001, so the reported 0.4939 and 0.4992 are the lowest of readings spanning 0.0022 at 300 s and 0.0001 at 3600 s, and neither the report nor the module says which premise is in force.

every row chains regardless of its status, so a request that did not complete (2560 of the report's 124339 rows, 2.06 percent, 340 of them carrying prompt tokens) both counts as a hit and refreshes its caller's previous arrival, and a completed request following a failed one inside the lifetime is scored a hit although nothing was served or cached; restricting the same rule to completed rows at the timestamp reading moves h at 300 s from 0.496154 to 0.495353 (0.34 percent of the prompt tokens sit in rows that did not complete), and no test covers a failed row, so the figure includes a population the plan's rule does not settle.

the landing fragment states arrival as the row's timestamp minus its duration and quotes 0.4939 without the arrival reading that produces it, so a reader of the durable evidence record takes both as measured facts, where the same code over the same rows gives 0.4962 under the producer's own timestamp semantics and nothing in the fragment or the report names the report's premise.
